design_system_name: Mashara Finance Modern SaaS/HRMS Design System

typography.font_rules: Use Inter throughout all components. Headings 600-700, Body 400-500, Menu 500-600, KPI numbers 600-700 with tabular figures.

surface.description: Card, panel, and table white background

border.description: Thin subtle 1px border for all cards, containers, and table cells

primary_brand.description: Professional blue for primary CTAs, active nav item indicators, and key highlights

primary_soft.description: Soft blue tint for active sidebar items, selected tab backgrounds, and hover accents

income_profit.description: Green for Income, Profit, Success states, positive trends, and active badges

expense.description: Red for Expense, Danger buttons, Negative trends, overdue states, and error alerts

investment.description: Blue/Indigo for Investment KPIs, partner capital visualizations, and secondary metrics

warning_pending.description: Amber for Pending approvals, Warning alerts, draft statuses, and action items

primary.description: Neutral dark gray text for maximum legibility

secondary.description: Muted gray text for labels, descriptions, and metadata

border_radius.md: rounded-md (6px) - Default for cards, inputs, buttons

shadows.rule: Very subtle shadows only where necessary. Strictly avoid heavy gradients, excessive glow, or high-blur shadows.

sidebar_spec.group_header: text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-400 px-3 py-2 mt-4
sidebar_spec.submenu_indentation: pl-9 pr-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 hover:text-[#002fa7] font-medium
sidebar_spec.collapse_behavior: Smooth accordion expansion for nested modules, keeping clear parent vs child visual hierarchy while preserving all RBAC visibility checks.

header_spec.background: bg-white border-b border-slate-200 sticky top-0 z-40 px-4 sm:px-6 flex items-center justify-between
components: Company Switcher dropdown + Company Code Chip (bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 text-xs font-mono font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-slate-200)
Pending Requests pill badge (bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5)
Notifications icon with unread indicator badge
User Profile Avatar + Dropdown with role badge

kpi_cards.container: bg-white rounded-md border border-slate-200 p-4 sm:p-5 shadow-sm hover:border-slate-300 transition-all
kpi_cards.layout: Flex container with small uppercase label on top, bold mono numeric value in center, icon badge on right, trend/percentage subtext at bottom

color_code_mapping.total_investment: Icon in blue/indigo soft container, metric text primary
color_code_mapping.total_income: Icon in green soft container, trend text in green (#00a859)
color_code_mapping.total_expense: Icon in red soft container, trend text in red (#ff2a2a)
color_code_mapping.net_profit: Icon in green soft container if positive, red soft container if negative

filter_bar.container: bg-white rounded-md border border-slate-200 p-3 sm:p-4 mb-6 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3

charts.styling: Clean Recharts or Shadcn chart wrappers with subtle gridlines (#f1f5f9), custom crisp tooltips, rounded bar edges (radius: [4, 4, 0, 0]), and responsive containers
charts_required: Monthly Trend (Line Chart with Income/Expense dual stroke)
Distribution (Pie/Donut Chart with semantic color segments)
Company Income (Bar Chart with clean numeric axis)
Partner Investment / Income / Expense (Multi-bar or Composed Chart)

tables.container: bg-white rounded-md border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm
tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-b border-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-600 py-3 px-4 text-left sticky top-0
tables.row: border-b border-slate-100 hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition-colors text-sm text-slate-800 py-3 px-4

status_badges.approved_active_paid: bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full
status_badges.pending_draft_review: bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border border-amber-200 text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full
status_badges.rejected_cancelled_overdue: bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border border-rose-200 text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full
status_badges.neutral_info: bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 border border-blue-200 text-xs font-semibold px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full

forms.label: text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-slate-700 mb-1.5 block
forms.input: h-9 sm:h-10 bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 text-sm text-slate-900 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002fa7]/20 focus:border-[#002fa7] transition-all

buttons.primary: bg-[#002fa7] hover:bg-[#00227d] text-white font-medium text-sm rounded-md px-4 py-2 shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-[0.99]
buttons.secondary: bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 font-medium text-sm rounded-md px-4 py-2 shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.danger: bg-[#ff2a2a] hover:bg-red-700 text-white font-medium text-sm rounded-md px-4 py-2 shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.success: bg-[#00a859] hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium text-sm rounded-md px-4 py-2 shadow-sm transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2

spacing_scale.philosophy: Generous SaaS whitespace with 4px grid alignment. Use p-4 to p-8 on card containers to prevent text collisions.

data_testid_rules.pattern: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, status badges, KPI cards, sidebar items, and action items must retain or include data-testid attributes in kebab-case format.

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply Inter font globally by ensuring index.css sets font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif on body and all headings.
Ensure CSS root variables reflect the exact Hex & HSL values for --brand (#002fa7), --success (#00a859), --danger (#ff2a2a), --warning (#f59e0b), --info (#4f46e5).
Keep all existing RBAC logic, permissions, state management, backend API paths, and calculations untouched.
Enhance the Sidebar component with clear module grouping, smooth collapsible submenus, soft blue active item highlights, and proper icon alignments.
Enhance Header component with company switcher dropdown, company code pill, pending approvals count, notification triggers, and user profile.
Redesign Dashboard KPI cards and filters into clean, modern SaaS components with crisp typography and subtle borders.
Ensure tables have sticky headers, compact comfortable row padding, responsive overflow wrappers, and status badges.
Use Sonner for all toast feedback messages.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI slop: maintain clear, crisp contrast with high legibility.
Never center-align the main app layout or dense tables.
Do NOT use AI emojis (🤖, 💡, 🔮) as visual icons — use Lucide React icons exclusively.
Every button and input must have clear hover, focus, and active micro-states.
Maintain all existing test IDs for reliable automated test suites.
